# Vendored Font Awesome Free 6.4.0

`css/all.min.css` and the `webfonts/*.woff2` files are Font Awesome Free 6.4.0
(https://fontawesome.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (icons), SIL OFL 1.1 (fonts)
and MIT (CSS). See `LICENSE.txt`.

The TrueType fallbacks were stripped from the stylesheet; only woff2 is shipped.
The build copies this directory into the served UI so no page loads from a CDN.
